findings.rationale: Verified: rule 6 said one fact per line while the header carries two spend figures, and meter/chart/chip/badge/note had no mandatory FactId. Granularity is now the fragment; the header exception is stated once; fact is required on every data-bearing builder and fragment (sec 2.6 rules 6-7, sec 4); I17 and its golden table widened; M51.

Verified: run precedence reached 'no rc, fresh -> running' with an unrecognised final_status. Sec 3.3 run row now has step 3 (present but unrecognised final_status -> unknown, before stall and freshness); I13 gains fixtures with and without rc, stall and freshness; M50.

Verified: sec 3.2 lists a triangle badge, running N, stalled N and residue N while I14 omitted stalled N and badge() had no residue discriminant. Replaced with stateBadge (need_you, running, stalled only) and residueBadge; I14 regex includes the stalled form, applies to strip and band; M48-M49.

Verified: group/ts were optional and I18/I22 covered only named lists. Added list() and section() builders with required group/ts, uniform cap for every list category and SECTION_ORDER per tab (sec 4, 6.1); I18 covers all categories, I22 pins section order; M52a-e, M53, M54.

Verified: there are five timed comparisons and four constants. Sec 2.5 now names F1-F5 each with its own FRESH_MS constant and X0/X1 as untimed branches; I11 uses T-1/T/T+1 for F1-F5 only; mutations M24a-e (flip), M24f-j (remove), M24k, M24l.

Verified: a kv value cannot hold a PaneLine and no blank builder existed. Sec 4 now separates line builders from branded Frag fragments (meterValue, badgeFragment, stateLead, formatter results), keeps meter as a full row, and adds blank(); kind union and header/strip descriptions updated.

Verified: the first seat sat in a kv value with no toggle. Chose one producible layout: a valueless kv for the seats key plus one toggled item per seat at column 12; sec 5.3 sketches closed and opened states (detail shifts right by 12); I18 and I23 cover opening the first seat; M55.

Verified: sec 3.4 rule 3 and Q1 use bold but sec 3.6 and I4 exclude it. Added both as explicit owner-approved exceptions tagged here (sec 3.6, I4, I20 counts a node and label as one value); M56 bold non-current stage label, M57 bold inactive tab. Bold not removed.
Verified: P4 cell said P0 but reads P1-P3. Dependency changed to P0-P3 and acceptance runs against exactly that predecessor state (sec 7).
Verified: Q2 allows the circled-dot fallback which was not in the P0 matrix. Added it to P0(b) and sec 3.4 rule 4; the other fallback is ASCII and needs no check.

Verified: sec 5.3 stacks four seats under one kv value with no producer. Adopted option (b), same change as the sol seat finding: bare seats key plus separate item rows, each with the round fact path via list() grouping.
Verified: sec 5.4 shows reset times but meter had no field. Added reset?: atMs to meter, rendering the relative-time formatter after the amount (sec 4 meter).
